tei:elementSpec.tei:desc: The movement map is the place to specify continuous movements of the performer over time, such as the piano's sustain and una corda pedals. Each movement is identified by its controller and described by a curve that is composed of monotonic segments, each segment is a movement element.

tei:exemplum.tei:p: A sustain pedal that is pressed to 85% of its travel, partially lifted to 30% and pressed again (a so-called half change), and finally released. In parallel, the una corda pedal is pressed slowly and held.

tei:remarks.tei:p: All controllers of a part (or of the global environment) share one movementMap. Each controller forms its own sequence of movement elements: a movement lasts until the next movement with the same controller, regardless of movements of other controllers in between.
